description: CR-CH-077 -- Single-chrome layout. The shared component owns exactly ONE Command ===> line and ONE column header; the Alias Context must NOT draw its own extra Title/command line on top. Live panel = single Context/Kind Title line + single Command ===> line + header + rows (Req 10.1-10.2). The Alias ScreenProvider snapshot must render the SAME single-chrome layout so live and snapshot agree -- the Command ===> line and the column header MUST appear in the captured model (today the snapshot omits them, Req 10.3). This is a REMOVE (the live duplicate) plus a FILL (the snapshot's missing chrome), both host-side, on existing seams only: no new chrome mechanism; no change to dispatch/navigation/save/descriptor (Req 10.4). Ordered LAST because it and FEAT-002 both touch the surface render and tests_focus.rs; doing it after the arrow walk avoids churn on the same render path.

Do NOT add a new chrome mechanism; do NOT touch dispatch/nav/save/descriptor (Req 10.4). Leave a short comment noting the same fix pattern applies to the Menu/Kinds hosts (out of scope here).

acceptance_criteria: alias_editor_screen_model carries the Command ===> line and the [Act, CE, Command, Alias, Parameters, Description] header so the captured snapshot shows Title -> Command -> header -> rows (Req 10.3).

No change to dispatch, Navigation_Stack return, WorkspaceKind/descriptor, pending_action, or the save seam (Req 10.4); the first-Tab focus test still passes.
findings:
DONE on branch ispf-editor-impl (worktree .worktrees/ispf-editor-impl). Single-chrome implemented per OWNER DECISION (2026-11-02), which overrides the literal Req 10.1/7.12 wording.

OWNER DECISION (important for later steps / Menu+Kinds hosts): the ONE surviving Title + command line are the SHELL's app-level render_title_line ('Alias Editor') + render_command_field ('Command ===>'), NOT the shared component's. The shared render_ispf_table surface now draws NEITHER a centred title NOR a 'Command ===>' line. When the Alias Context is active, run_command_line routes the shell command field into the Alias command-environment handler (apply_alias_command_line): apply pending Act line commands FIRST, then FILTER/RESET/SORT panel-locally, then fall through to the single FFCMD front door for SAVE/END/RETURN/REFRESH. This matches the owner's command-environment model (the active Workspace Kind is the active command environment, defaulting through FFCMD) and keeps the single dispatch/save seam intact. This is the reusable pattern for the future Menu/Kinds table-editor hosts: do NOT re-add a per-surface command line; rely on the shell field + the host's command-line handler.

CODE CHANGES (ff-desktop):
- shell/ispf_table_editor/render.rs: removed the centred title draw and the 'Command ===>' TextEdit from render_ispf_table; removed the `title` field from TableRenderParams; removed command_line_id from the IspfTableRender trait; removed the now-unreachable TableAction::CommandLine variant (surface only emits None/ApplyLineCommands via the Act-cell Enter); arrow walk now always calls apply_arrow_walk (it self-guards on matrix focus, so the command field keeps its Up/Down history gesture, Req 11.5).
- alias_editor_panel/render.rs: dropped the title param + the command_line in/out plumbing; maps TableAction -> AliasEditorAction (None/ApplyLineCommands only).
- alias_editor_panel/host.rs: removed the command_line_id impl + its doc.
- alias_editor_panel/state.rs: removed AliasEditorAction::CommandLine (production routes typed verbs straight to apply_alias_command_line); ApplyLineCommands retained.
- shell/alias_editor.rs: apply_alias_editor_action drops the CommandLine arm.
- shell/commands_line.rs: run_command_line routes to apply_alias_command_line when KindTag::AliasEditor is active, else dispatch_command_string (unchanged for every other Context).

SNAPSHOT (Req 10.3) was ALREADY SATISFIED by the existing provider: alias_editor_screen_model sets model.command_line = self.command_text and pushes alias_table() (headers in ALIAS_COLUMNS order [Act,CE,Command,Alias,Parameters,Description]). No provider code change needed; added a regression-guard test. Note command_line is sourced from the SHELL command text, which is correct under the owner's single-command-line decision.

TESTS:
- NEW full_shell_alias_editor_is_single_chrome (shell/tests_focus.rs): asserts exactly ONE 'Command ===>' node, ZERO 'FileForge Workbench Alias Editor' heading, ONE 'Alias Editor' title via the accessibility tree. Use query_all_by_label (NOT get_all_by_label) for zero-match assertions -- get_all_by_label PANICS when nothing matches.
- NEW full_shell_alias_screen_model_carries_command_line_and_header (shell/tests_screen_directive.rs): snapshot regression guard (Req 10.3).
- UPDATED the two full-shell tests that drove the removed surface field (empty_store_i_insert, cc_block_copies_after_target) + the alias unit tests that constructed AliasEditorAction::CommandLine -> now call run_command_line("")/apply_alias_command_line(...) (the real seam).
- full_shell_alias_editor_first_tab_focuses_first_interior still passes (entry control + InteriorFocus anchors unchanged).
